title: WPMS/48/2007 of SRI RAM KISHAN AND ANOTHER Vs SEC ADDITIONAL DISTT JUDGE HARIDWAR AND ORS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 48 of 2007
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
None is present for the petitioner.
MCC No. 647 of 2013
Writ petition was dismissed for non-prosecution
vide order dated 12.08.2013; restoration application
being MCC No. 647 of 2013 was filed by the
petitioner on 07.10.2013; vide order dated 08.10.2013,
counsel for the petitioner was permitted to cure defects
within two weeks; however, defects could not be cured
within time; again vide order dated 27.06.2014, time
was granted to remove defects; however, defects were
not removed; again vide order dated 04.09.2015,
counsel for the petitioner was permitted to remove
defects on or before 08.09.2015; this time too defects
have not been cured as yet.
I have perused the explanation furnished by the
Office. Office is advised to be more careful and
vigilant in future.
Restoration Application (MCC No. 647 of
2013) is dismissed of non-prosecution.
(Alok Singh, J.)
 09.09.2015
Deepak
